description: HUMAN profile: tries 50, 100 and 150 point spreads and long strikes up to two steps out of the money (a trader sizes the spread to the budget), and accepts ordinary option liquidity (bid-ask up to 5% of mid, volume 2,000, open interest 10,000). Compared with config/strategy_thresholds.json (100/150 points, 0-1 steps, 3%, 5,000, 20,000). The per-trade risk limit is NOT changed: the pipeline takes the best-ranked spread that fits it. Still OUR choices, NOT validated on real market data.
